data.title: Jack Henry Expands Collaboration with Google Cloud to Deliver Tokenized Deposits for Banks and Credit Unions | JKHY Stock News
data.description:
Jack Henry (Nasdaq: JKHY) expanded its collaboration with Google Cloud, planning an integration to support tokenized deposits for banks and credit unions.

See more from StockTitan in Google Search and AI answers.Adds StockTitan as a preferred source · opens Google
Add on Google
  • Jack Henry will be the first core banking technology provider to integrate with Google Cloud Universal Ledger (GCUL)
  • Expanded capabilities help financial institutions innovate, retain deposits, and deliver new digital experiences
  • The announcement builds on the strategic relationship Jack Henry and Google Cloud established in 2022

MONETT, Mo., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Jack Henry® (Nasdaq: JKHY) today announced an expansion of its collaboration with Google Cloud designed to pave the way for banks and credit unions to offer tokenized deposits through Google Cloud Universal Ledger (GCUL). As part of the expanding relationship, Jack Henry will become the first core technology provider to integrate with GCUL, helping financial institutions modernize deposit offerings, strengthen accountholder relationships, and introduce new payment and settlement capabilities. GCUL is a fully managed, distributed ledger service that enables financial institutions to tokenize and transfer money and assets on a shared, real-time record with programmable, 24/7 settlement capabilities.

As consumer and business expectations continue to evolve toward real-time, programmable, and seamless financial experiences, community and regional financial institutions face growing competition from large banks and fintech providers. By integrating tokenized deposit infrastructure into Jack Henry's ecosystem, banks and credit unions can explore new transactional use cases, enhance digital experiences, and position themselves to meet emerging market demands.

"Tokenized deposits have the potential to reshape how money moves across the financial ecosystem," said Jack Henry Chief Technology Officer Ben Metz. "Our strategy is centered on helping financial institutions navigate emerging technologies and access innovative capabilities through trusted, scalable infrastructure. By expanding our work with Google Cloud and serving as the first core technology provider to use GCUL, we're helping community banks and credit unions explore new opportunities while building on the relationships, service, and expertise that have always set them apart."

Jack Henry and Google Cloud established their strategic relationship in 2022 to accelerate Jack Henry's cloud-native technology modernization strategy. Last June, the companies announced plans to deliver AI-driven security capabilities, integrating Google Cloud's agentic defense solutions to protect banks and credit unions against increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. The integration with GCUL combines modern ledger technology with secure, scalable cloud infrastructure to help financial institutions explore new digital asset and payment capabilities.

Key benefits of tokenized deposits through GCUL include:

  • Deposit Retention and Growth: Helps financial institutions retain deposit relationships while offering emerging digital payment and value-transfer capabilities.
  • 24/7 Programmable User Experience and Near Real-Time Settlement: Provides end clients with instant, 24/7/365 payment execution and automated, programmable workflows across an expanding network of institutional participants, currencies, and asset classes. Supports automated settlement processes and programmable payment workflows that can improve efficiency and flexibility.
  • Seamless Integration: Leverages Jack Henry's modern architecture to simplify adoption and reduce operational complexity.
  • Trusted Enterprise Infrastructure: Blends Jack Henry's modern architecture to minimize operational friction and simplify adoption with Google Cloud's secure, scalable, and resilient distributed ledger infrastructure.
  • Capital Efficiency: Maximizes capital efficiency through automated clearing and multilateral netting without requiring liquidity tie-ups or pre-funded accounts, enabling institutions to scale digital asset capabilities while fully preserving core reserves and primary deposit relationships.

"Financial innovation should be accessible to institutions of all sizes," said James Tromans, director, Web3 and Digital Assets at Google Cloud. "Google Cloud Universal Ledger provides a secure and scalable foundation for programmable value exchange. Through our collaboration with Jack Henry, we are bringing advanced digital asset capabilities to community and regional financial institutions, helping them build on the relationships and trust they have established with their customers."

About Jack Henry & Associates, Inc.®
Jack Henry® (Nasdaq: JKHY) is a well-rounded financial technology company that strengthens connections between financial institutions and the people and businesses they serve. We are an S&P 500 company that prioritizes openness, collaboration, and user centricity – offering banks and credit unions a vibrant ecosystem of internally developed modern capabilities as well as the ability to integrate with leading fintechs. For 50 years, Jack Henry has provided technology solutions to enable clients to innovate faster, strategically differentiate, and successfully compete while serving the evolving needs of their accountholders. We empower more than 7,200 clients with people-inspired innovation, personal service, and insight-driven solutions that help reduce the barriers to financial health. Additional information is available at www.jackhenry.com.

FRANKLIN, IN / ACCESS Newswire / October 16, 2026 / IBC Advanced Alloys Corp. ("IBC" or the "Company") (TSXV:IB)(OTCQB:IAALF) announces its financial results for the quarter and year ended June 30, 2026.

Stronger demand for the Company's copper-based products in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 boosted revenue to $5.7 million, a 19.4% increase over the comparable prior-year period. Market conditions and uncertainty about government policies related to copper tariffs adversely affected sales in the first three quarters of the fiscal year, but annual sales of $19.5 million finished 9.8% higher than the year ended June 30, 2025. IBC's stronger product demand has been driven largely by companies in the naval defense and electronics industries.

For the year, the Company narrowed losses in operating and net income compared with the prior-year period and posted Adjusted EBITDA of $591,000, reversing a $400,000 loss in the prior-year period.

data.description:
The added markets carry no separate funding obligation, while the existing $15 million aggregate minimum funding requirement remains unchanged.

BMRT’s Base Molecular Resonance™ Technology Detects the Molecular Signature of a Concealed Firearm from More Than 500 Feet Away and Identifies Drugs Inside Vehicles and Backpacks at a Distance; Expansion Adds More Than 374,000 U.S. Congregations and Treatment Facilities to SafeSpace Global’s Addressable Market

KNOXVILLE, Tenn., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SafeSpace Global Corporation (OTCID: SSGC) (“SafeSpace Global” or the “Company”), a publicly traded, applied multimodal AI-powered physical safety and security technology company, today announced that BMRT Security, Inc. (“BMRT”) has extended the Company’s exclusive commercialization rights to include houses of worship and addiction treatment facilities. The addendum adds two new markets to SafeSpace Global’s existing exclusive rights in K-12 schools and correctional facilities, giving the Company exclusive access to BMRT’s concealed weapons and drug detection technology in four of the most sensitive environments in the country.

Conventional screening finds a threat only when someone is stopped at a checkpoint. BMRT is designed to find it earlier. Its proprietary Base Molecular Resonance™ (BMR™) technology identifies the molecular signature of a target substance at a distance, giving schools, congregations, treatment centers and correctional facilities the potential to detect a concealed weapon or drugs before a person or vehicle reaches the door.

What BMRT Does

  • Concealed weapons detection. BMR™ detects the molecular signature associated with a firearm. In documented testing, the technology detected an AR-15 from more than 500 feet away.
  • Drug detection. BMR™ identifies the molecular signatures of drugs concealed inside a vehicle or a backpack, at a distance.
  • Earlier warning. Detection at range is intended to give security personnel and law enforcement more time to assess and respond.

“BMRT does what the security industry has long struggled to do: in documented testing, it detected a concealed rifle from more than 500 feet away, before an armed individual ever reached the front door,” said Scott M. Boruff, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of SafeSpace Global. “Bringing that capability to schools, correctional facilities, houses of worship and addiction treatment centers, places that are meant to be open and welcoming, is central to our mission to help save lives.”

Expanding SafeSpace Global’s Addressable Markets

Under the addendum, SafeSpace Global’s exclusive commercialization rights for BMRT’s detection technology now cover four markets:

  • K-12 Schools and Educational Campuses;
  • Correctional Facilities;
  • Houses of Worship; and,
  • Addiction Treatment and Rehabilitation Facilities.

According to the 2020 U.S. Religion Census, there were approximately 356,739 religious congregations in the United States. Separately, the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (“SAMHSA”) identified 17,829 substance use treatment facilities in its 2024 survey universe.

The Company believes the addendum creates opportunities to pair BMRT’s detection technology with its AI-powered physical safety platform, existing commercialization infrastructure and strategic relationships across additional markets while pursuing potential recurring subscription, integration and deployment revenues.

“Our mission is to help save lives, and expanding the number of markets we can serve directly supports that mission.” Boruff said. “Every school, correctional facility, house of worship and treatment center represents people who deserve to feel safe. We believe that expanding our commercial reach and expanding our ability to protect people go hand in hand.”

Exclusive Commercialization Rights

Under the expanded agreement, SafeSpace Global receives exclusive rights, subject to the terms and conditions of the agreement to market, license, sell, commercialize, integrate and deploy BMRT’s covered technology within houses of worship and addiction treatment facilities.

Importantly, the expansion does not create a separate funding obligation or increase the existing $15 million aggregate minimum funding requirement under the original agreement. The additional markets remain subject to the applicable funding, development, commercialization, continuation and termination provisions of the underlying agreement.

“We believe this is a highly strategic way to grow our business.” Boruff added. “We are expanding into significant new markets under our existing exclusive relationship without increasing the aggregate funding requirement. Our objective is to leverage the technology and infrastructure we are already developing to protect more people, serve more customers and create additional opportunities for recurring revenue and long-term shareholder value.”

About SafeSpace Global Corporation

SafeSpace Global Corporation (OTCID: SSGC) is a publicly traded technology company providing proprietary, applied multimodal, AI-powered physical safety solutions in its mission to help save lives. Headquartered in Knoxville, Tennessee, the Company has its Tennessee AI Center of Excellence and regional office in Nashville, Tennessee. Learn more at SafeSpaceGlobal.ai.

About BMRT Security, Inc.

BMRT Security, Inc. applies proprietary Base Molecular Resonance™ (BMR™) technology to public safety, law enforcement and national security applications. Developed by Base Molecular Resonance™ Technologies, LLC, a deep technology company that has described its work as involving a novel area of quantum physics, BMR™ uses resonant frequencies to identify specific molecular signatures, including those associated with firearms and drugs. In documented testing, the technology detected the molecular signature of an AR-15 from more than 500 feet away. In independent blind and double-blind testing conducted by the Centre for Applied Innovation at York St John University, the technology reported high levels of accuracy under controlled conditions. It subsequently produced notable results in a United States Combatant Command-sponsored test. Learn more at www.BMRT.io.

data.title: DEWALT and August Robotics' Downward Drilling Robot Named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 | SWK Stock News
data.description:
Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) announced that its DEWALT brand's DALE drilling robot earned recognition among TIME's Best Inventions of 2026.

  • DALE™, the world's first fleet-capable downward drilling robot, recognized in the Robotics category for advancing speed, precision, and safety in data center construction
  • Robot selected by TIME editors as one of 300 extraordinary innovations changing how we live, work, play, and think about what's possible
  • Developed in collaboration with August Robotics, DALE drills at speeds up to 10 times faster than traditional methods, reduced project timelines by more than 300 weeks across 44 data center construction phases, and achieved over 99% accuracy drilling more than 385,000 holes

TOWSON, Md., Oct. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DEWALT, a Stanley Black & Decker brand renowned for relentless innovation on the jobsite, today announced that DALE, its autonomous downward drilling robot developed in collaboration with global mobile robotics leader August Robotics, has been named to TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 list in the Robotics category. Nominated and evaluated by TIME editors and correspondents around the world, the winning 300 innovations were selected based on originality, efficacy, ambition, and impact.

Designed to dramatically improve how concrete drilling is performed, DALE is helping redefine data center construction at a time when demand for new computing capacity continues to accelerate. To date, on live data center jobsites, DALE has achieved drilling speeds up to 10 times faster than conventional methods, helped reduce project timelines by more than 300 weeks across 44 phases of data center construction, and delivered over 99% accuracy across more than 385,000 holes.

"We are honored that TIME has recognized DALE as one of the Best Inventions of 2026. DALE is an example of DEWALT's drive to deliver hyper-focused innovation to our end users and how advanced technology can be applied in a practical, results-driven way," said Bill Beck, President, Tools & Outdoor, Stanley Black & Decker. "This is about bringing new capability to the jobsite and helping customers meet rising demands with greater productivity and improved safety."

After earning strong industry attention earlier this year and entering the market as a breakthrough solution optimized for data center construction, DALE continues to demonstrate how advanced automation can improve execution on large-scale infrastructure projects. Its recognition by TIME further validates the role robotics can play in helping customers increase output, simplify workflows, boost safety, and support the pace of modern building.

See the full list of TIME's Best Inventions of 2026 at: ti.me/best-inventions. 

To learn more about the robot and DEWALT's industry-leading solutions for jobsite professionals, visit www.dewalt.com.

HOUSTON, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Moleculin Biotech, Inc., (Nasdaq: MBRX) (“Moleculin” or the “Company”), today announced that it filed an amendment to its amended and restated certificate of incorporation with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware to effect a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its common stock. The reverse stock split will take effect at 12:01 am (Eastern Time) on October 20, 2026, and the Company’s common stock will open for trading on The Nasdaq Capital Market on October 20, 2026 on a post-split basis, under the existing ticker symbol “MBRX” but with a new CUSIP number 60855D 507.

As a result of the reverse stock split, every 20 shares of the Company’s common stock issued and outstanding prior to the opening of trading on October 20, 2026 will be consolidated into one issued and outstanding share, with no change in the nominal par value per share of $0.001. No fractional shares will be issued if, as a result of the reverse stock split, a stockholder would become entitled to a fractional share because the number of shares of common stock they hold before the reverse stock split is not evenly divisible by the split ratio. Instead, the stockholder will be entitled to receive a cash payment in lieu of a fractional share.

As a result of the reverse stock split, the number of shares of common stock outstanding will be reduced from approximately 20.9 million shares to approximately 1.05 million shares, and the number of authorized shares of common stock will remain at 500 million shares.

About Moleculin Biotech, Inc.

Moleculin Biotech, Inc. is a Phase 3 clinical stage pharmaceutical company advancing a pipeline of therapeutic candidates addressing hard-to-treat tumors and viruses. The Company’s lead program, Annamycin (also known as naxtarubicin), has shown to be an efficacious and well tolerated anthracycline designed to avoid multidrug resistance mechanisms and to lack the cardiotoxicity common with currently prescribed anthracyclines. Annamycin is currently in development for the treatment of relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and soft tissue sarcoma (STS) lung metastases.

The Company is conducting the MIRACLE (Moleculin R/R AML AnnAraC Clinical Evaluation) Trial (MB-108), a pivotal, adaptive design, multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2/3 trial evaluating Annamycin in combination with cytarabine (also referred to as “Ara-C”), together referred to as AnnAraC, for the treatment of relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia. Following a successful Phase 1B/2 study (MB-106), with input from the FDA, the Company believes it has substantially de-risked the development pathway toward a potential approval for Annamycin for the treatment of AML. This study remains subject to appropriate future filings with potential additional feedback from the FDA and their foreign equivalents.

Additionally, the Company is developing WP1066, an Immune/Transcription Modulator capable of inhibiting p-STAT3 and other oncogenic transcription factors while also stimulating a natural immune response, targeting brain tumors, pancreatic and other cancers. Moleculin also has in its pipeline a portfolio of antimetabolites, including WP1122 for the potential treatment of pathogenic viruses, as well as certain cancer indications.

For more information about the Company, please visit www.moleculin.com and connect on X, LinkedIn and Facebook.

DALLAS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Copart, Inc. (NASDAQ: CPRT) (“Copart”), a global leader in online vehicle auctions, today announced the successful completion of its acquisition of ACV Auctions Inc. (NYSE: ACVA) (“ACV”).

“We are pleased to complete the acquisition of ACV, which is an important milestone for Copart as we continue to deliver on our growth strategy,” said Jay Adair, Chief Executive Officer of Copart. “With ACV now part of the Copart family, we have established an industry-leading, fully complete remarketing platform spanning dealer trade-ins, wholesale remarketing, salvage disposition, and international scale. Together we bring stronger capabilities, great efficiency, and an expansive footprint, and we’re excited about what we will be able to deliver for our customers moving forward.”

Completion of Tender Offer and Transaction Details

Copart completed the cash tender offer, through its wholly owned subsidiary Apple Merger Sub, Inc. (“Purchaser”), to acquire all of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of ACV at a purchase price of $10.50 per share, net to the seller in cash, without interest, subject to any applicable withholding taxes. As of the tender offer expiration at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on October 15, 2026, 116,818,409 shares of ACV common stock were validly tendered (and not validly withdrawn), representing approximately 68.43% of the total number of ACV's issued and outstanding shares of common stock as of such date and time. All such shares have been accepted for payment in accordance with the terms of the tender offer, and Copart, on behalf of Purchaser, will promptly pay for such shares.

Following the completion of the tender offer, Copart completed the acquisition of ACV through the merger of Purchaser with ACV. As a result of the merger, each share of ACV common stock issued and outstanding and not tendered in the tender offer was cancelled and converted into the right to receive the same $10.50 per share in cash, without interest, subject to any applicable withholding taxes, paid in the tender offer.

With the completion of the acquisition, shares of ACV common stock have ceased trading on the New York Stock Exchange and ACV will now operate as an independent subsidiary of Copart led by ACV’s existing leadership team.

“ACV’s mission is not complete and we will continue to revolutionize the used vehicle sector,” noted George Chamoun, CEO of ACV. “Joining with Copart amplifies this mission, supercharging our growth, pace of innovation and global reach. By combining forces and tapping into Copart's massive national physical presence alongside a global buyer-seller network—we will unlock unprecedented value for our commercial and dealership partners, ensuring every vehicle finds its ideal buyer. I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to our exceptional ACV team and we are thrilled to embark on this next chapter with the Copart team.”

Advisors

Evercore served as financial advisor to Copart, Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati, Professional Corporation served as legal counsel, and FGS Global served as strategic communications advisor.

J.P. Morgan Securities LLC served as exclusive financial advisor and provided a fairness opinion to ACV, Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP served as legal counsel, and Joele Frank, Wilkinson Brimmer Katcher served as strategic communications advisor.

About Copart

Copart, Inc., founded in 1982, is a global leader in online vehicle auctions. Copart’s innovative technology and online auction platforms connect vehicle consignors to approximately 1 million members in over 185 countries. Copart offers a comprehensive suite of vehicle remarketing services to insurance companies, financial institutions, dealers, rental car companies, charities, fleet operators, and individuals, and offers vehicles via auction to dealers, dismantlers, rebuilders, exporters, and the general public. With operations at over 250 locations in 11 countries, Copart sold more than 4 million units in the last year. For more information, visit Copart.com.

Thomas moves from president and general manager of TEGNA’s Tampa and Jacksonville stations

MCLEAN, Va., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TEGNA Inc. (NASDAQ: NXST) today announced that it has appointed Tim Thomas to lead WXIA, the company’s NBC affiliate in Atlanta, its sister station, WATL, and WMAZ, the CBS affiliate in Macon. He will be responsible for overseeing station operations across platforms and driving results for advertisers.

Thomas brings a proven track record of innovation and performance to the position. An experienced media executive with more than two decades of leadership across broadcast, digital, and station operations, Thomas is currently serving as president and general manager of TEGNA Florida, leading the company’s Tampa-St. Petersburg and Jacksonville operations and overseeing a multi-market strategy focused on audience growth, revenue, streaming and operational performance.

Thomas succeeds president and general manager Kristie Gonzales at WXIA-WATL and WMAZ. Gonzales has been named a vice president of ad sales, overseeing the sales teams in TEGNA’s Northeast and Southeast regions.

“Tim is a visionary leader who blends operational excellence with clear insight into what drives our future growth and success,” said Joan Barrett, group general manager for TEGNA’s Northeast and Southeast regions. “We are confident he will bring that same passion, energy, and proven track record to the Atlanta and Macon markets.”

“I was at WXIA earlier in my career, and I’m excited to return to continue the station’s success across platforms,” said Thomas. “I’m looking forward to working with the teams in Atlanta and Macon to create meaningful content and to develop new opportunities that will increase our impact for viewers and advertisers.”

Before assuming his role in Florida, Thomas served as president and general manager of TEGNA’s West Texas stations, KWES, KXVA, and KIDY, where he led all operations and significantly increased broadcast share. Under his leadership, KWES was awarded a Regional Edward R. Murrow Award for Overall Excellence in 2022. Prior to that, Thomas acted as station operations manager for WXIA-WATL in Atlanta, where he oversaw local on-air and digital programming and developed new business opportunities.

About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NXST), operating independently of Nexstar consistent with the Hold Separate Order issued by the United States District Court for the Eastern District of California on April 17, 2026. TEGNA is a multiplatform media company operating 64 local television stations in 51 U.S. markets, and hundreds of websites, mobile and Connected TV (CTV) apps, and Premion, a leading Connected TV and Over-the-Top (OTT) advertising platform.

Over $20,000 to be awarded in Lights, Camera, Save!

ALEXANDRIA, Va., Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Burke & Herbert Bank & Trust Company (“Burke & Herbert” or “Bank”) calls for teens, ages 13 – 18, to submit entries for the 2026-27 Lights, Camera, Save! video contest. The contest, organized by the American Bankers Association Foundation, is a national competition that encourages teens to use video to communicate the value of wise money management and encourage other teens to engage in positive financial behavior.

“As a community bank, we are proud to support a contest that encourages teens to help their peers build stronger financial habits,” said Bank Chief Executive Officer David Boyle. “For over a decade, we have seen the impact young people can have through this contest in making financial education relatable. We encourage parents and educators to inspire students to participate and join us in preparing the next generation for a strong financial future.”

To participate, students must create a video, 30-seconds or less in length, about using money wisely and submit a link to the video along with a completed entry form to the bank by December 1, 2026. The contest is open to filmmakers of all experience levels.

Burke & Herbert Bank will host a regional round of judging in Delaware, Kentucky, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, and West Virginia. The Bank will select a winner from each state to compete on the national level for one of three cash prizes, including $10,000 for first place, $5,000 for second place, and $2,500 for third place. National contestants will face off head-to-head in the first round of national judging on ABA’s Instagram page which will determine which videos advance to the second round of national judging.

Burke & Herbert Bank is rewarding the top regional winners in each of its six state markets with a $500 prize. The Bank also is awarding a $100 gift card to the teacher of each of the first-place regional winners.

Videos will be judged based on their quality, message, content, and the criteria set forth by the contest's official rules. To learn more about the Lights, Camera, Save! Video Contest, visit burkeandherbertbank.com/contest or email save@burkeandherbertbank.com.

RALEIGH, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions that connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, today announced it has been named one of Newsweek's America's Greenest Companies 2027. The annual ranking recognizes organizations that demonstrate strong environmental stewardship and measurable progress in sustainability performance. Companies are evaluated using publicly available data across a range of environmental criteria, including greenhouse gas emissions, water management, waste reduction, sustainability disclosures, and environmental commitments.

"This recognition reflects our unwavering commitment to creating a more sustainable future while enabling our customers to operate more efficiently and responsibly," said Elaine Kanak, Chief Marketing Officer at Vontier. "Across our portfolio, we are helping customers reduce emissions, improve efficiency, and navigate the transition to cleaner and more sustainable solutions."

Vontier's portfolio of mobility technologies supports sustainability outcomes across the transportation ecosystem. Through solutions that advance alternative fuels, electric vehicle charging, fueling efficiency, fleet optimization, and vehicle maintenance, the company helps customers improve productivity while reducing environmental impact. These efforts are further supported by Vontier's ongoing focus on operational excellence, responsible business practices, workplace safety, and transparent sustainability reporting.

The recognition adds to a growing list of sustainability and corporate responsibility honors received by Vontier in recent years, including inclusion on Newsweek's Most Responsible Companies list, TIME's World's Most Sustainable Companies ranking, and leading ESG ratings from organizations including MSCI and Sustainalytics.

Vontier continues to advance enterprise-wide sustainability initiatives while empowering customers with technologies that help improve efficiency, reduce emissions, and support the evolving needs of the global mobility industry.

About Vontier

Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves — delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Vontier has a culture of continuous improvement and innovation worldwide. Additional information about Vontier is available on the Company’s website at www.vontier.com.

The Toll Brothers Sales Center and model home is now open at 7177 Myrtle Burl Way in Spartanburg, ideally situated directly across from the Carolina Country Club, just minutes from downtown Spartanburg, and approx. 30 miles from Greenville.

Toll Brothers at Everly is a master-planned community offering luxury single-family homes with modern architecture and versatile floor plans. Home shoppers can select from expansive designs ranging from approximately 2,500 to over 4,900 square feet, featuring first- or second-floor primary bedroom suites, open-concept living spaces, covered patios, and options for finished basements. Homes are situated on spacious home sites measuring over one-third acre and are priced from the upper $400,000s.


The community boasts exceptional amenities, including three resort-style clubhouses, each with a fitness center and pool, as well as pickleball and bocce ball courts, playgrounds, walking trails, and a 12-acre lake with a pier, pavilion, and beach. Located directly across from the prestigious Carolina Country Club, Toll Brothers at Everly offers convenience to downtown Spartanburg, top-rated golf courses, dining options, and highly ranked schools in Spartanburg County School District 6.

"Toll Brothers at Everly exemplifies the luxury lifestyle that Toll Brothers is known for, with modern home designs and an extraordinary selection of amenities that appeal to today's home shoppers," said Jason Simpson, Group President of Toll Brothers in South Carolina. "We are excited to bring this exceptional new community to Spartanburg and invite home shoppers to tour our professionally decorated model homes and experience everything this community has to offer."

Toll Brothers customers will experience one-stop shopping at the Toll Brothers Design Studio. The state-of-the-art Design Studio allows home shoppers to choose from a wide array of selections to personalize their dream home with the assistance of Toll Brothers professional Design Consultants.

Bogotá, Colombia, Oct. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GeoPark Limited (“GeoPark” or the “Company”) (NYSE: GPRK), an exempted company incorporated under the laws of Bermuda, today announced that it intends to offer senior notes (the “Notes”), guaranteed by certain subsidiaries of the Company, in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers in accordance with Rule 144A under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), and outside the United States to non-U.S. persons in accordance with Regulation S under the Securities Act. The timing of pricing and terms of the Notes are subject to market conditions and other factors.

Concurrent with the announcement of this proposed offering of Notes, the Company has announced that it is making a cash tender offer to purchase any and all of the Company’s outstanding 8.750% notes due 2030 (the "Notes due 2030"). The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the offering of the Notes to repurchase the Notes due 2030 tendered pursuant to the Concurrent Tender Offer, to repay or redeem, in whole or in part, certain of its existing indebtedness, including the Company’s 5.500% senior notes due 2027 (the “Notes due 2027”), to fund capital expenditures related to the development of the Company’s Vaca Muerta assets over the next 18 months, and for general corporate purposes.

This press release does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy these securities, nor will there be any sale of these securities, in any state or jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of any state or jurisdiction. The Notes have not been registered under the Securities Act, or any applicable state securities laws, and will be offered only to qualified institutional buyers pursuant to Rule 144A promulgated under the Securities Act and outside the United States to non-U.S. persons in accordance with Regulation S under the Securities Act. Unless so registered, the Notes may not be offered or sold in the United States except pursuant to an exemption from the registration requirements of the Securities Act and any applicable state securities laws.

HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The board of directors of Phillips 66 (NYSE: PSX) has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.33 per share on Phillips 66 common stock, representing a $0.06 increase. The dividend is payable on Dec. 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on Nov. 17, 2026.

“We are pleased to increase the quarterly dividend, reflecting the continued strength and resilience of the business and our commitment to deliver long-term returns to shareholders,” said Mark Lashier, chairman and CEO of Phillips 66. “This marks the second dividend increase in 2026 and brings the annualized dividend increase to 10.8% compared with the fourth quarter of 2025. The dividend increase underscores our confidence in the durability of the business model and the company’s ability to generate sustainable cash flow.”

“Since the company’s formation in 2012, we have increased the annual dividend every year, resulting in a significant 14% compound annual growth rate,” Lashier said. “With our disciplined approach to capital allocation, we are returning capital to shareholders, investing in long-term growth and maintaining a strong financial position as we execute our strategy and create long-term value.”

About Phillips 66

Phillips 66 (NYSE: PSX) is a leading integrated downstream energy provider that manufactures, transports and markets products that drive the global economy. The company’s portfolio includes Midstream, Chemicals, Refining, Marketing and Specialties, and Renewable Fuels businesses. Headquartered in Houston, TX, Phillips 66 has employees around the globe who are committed to safely and reliably providing energy and improving lives while pursuing a lower-carbon future. For more information, visit phillips66.com or follow @Phillips66Co on LinkedIn.
